videos.title: Why Your Enterprise Tech Stack Isn’t Ready for AI Agents — Christopher Lovejoy & Saul Howard
videos.summary: Building a working AI agent proof-of-concept takes weeks, but taking it into high-stakes, heavily regulated enterprise environments usually hits an immediate wall of compliance, privacy, and security audits. If you are building agentic systems that need to survive enterprise security reviews and real-world deployment, this session is mandatory watching.
